event.description:
Join us for the VPC Grand Archive Store Championship! The winner of this event will be awarded a Wildcard Nationals Qualifier that can be redeemed towards qualifying for National Championships. Bring a constructed deck and test your skills in a friendly competitive setting while enjoying a complimentary craft drink from the bar!

Time and date: 
Saturday, May 30th, 11:00 AM (event starts at 11:00 AM SHARP)

Entry fee: $20 
Entry includes 1 participation promo, 1 RDO booster pack, and 1 drink of your choice (excluding bottled alcohol) 
Purchase: https://victory-point-cafe.square.site 
32 player cap. Purchase is required to reserve a spot.  Decklists are mandatory for this event. Please submit decklists through Omnidex when registering.

Format: 
4 or 5-round Swiss tournament depending on turnout (no top cut)

Prizes: 
1 event pack per win, with additional prizes for top 8: 
1st place: 1 Wildcard Nationals Qualifier, 1 Store Championship Playmat, 8 booster packs
2nd place: 8 booster packs 
3rd place: 6 booster packs 
4th place: 4 booster packs
5th-8th place: 2 booster packs
event.name: VPC Store Championship - RDO Season
